title_ru: ВОЗВРАТ — FALCON 9, STARSHIP И МНОГОРАЗОВЫЕ РАКЕТЫ
description: An interactive field guide to reusable rockets: what it costs in payload to keep propellant for a booster landing (downrange vs. back at the launch site), why a Falcon 9 booster cannot hover and must time its landing burn to the metre, the first landings and reflights from 2015 to today, and Starship's Super Heavy booster caught by the launch tower.
og: How much payload a booster landing costs, why a Falcon 9 cannot hover, and the tower catch of Super Heavy — reusable rockets, interactive and sourced.
brand: RETURN — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
